items.title_en: He walks away as bike goes flying: Terrifying crash caught on CCTV
items.title_zh: 当自行车飞起来时他走开：闭路电视捕捉到可怕的车祸
items.summary_en: The viral video captures the terrifying moment when the speeding car crashes into the motorcycle, sending it flying.
items.summary_zh: 这段疯传的视频捕捉到了超速行驶的汽车撞上摩托车、将其飞飞的可怕时刻。

items.title_en: Indian woman meets MrBeast on day 365 of year-long challenge, wins $10,000
items.title_zh: 印度女子在为期一年的挑战赛第 365 天遇到 MrBeast，赢得 10,000 美元
items.summary_en: Through her Instagram account, @mayaforbeast, Gupta regularly shared updates, encouraging followers to support her efforts to reach the YouTube star.
items.summary_zh: 古普塔通过她的 Instagram 帐户@mayaforbeast 定期分享最新动态，鼓励粉丝支持她为接触这位 YouTube 明星所做的努力。

items.title_en: ‘Pick it up’: Voice from above stuns Greater Noida man dumping garbage on street
items.title_zh: “捡起来”：上面的声音震惊了大诺伊达街上倾倒垃圾的男子
items.summary_en: A CCTV operator in Greater Noida’s Sector Beta 1 used a public announcement system to call out a man attempting to dump garbage at night, warning him of a fine until he retrieved the waste and walked away.
items.summary_zh: 大诺伊达 Beta 1 区的一名闭路电视操作员利用公共广播系统对一名试图在夜间倾倒垃圾的男子发出警告，警告他将被处以罚款，直到他捡起垃圾并走开为止。
